body:
## AIWS agent docs

Before writing AIWS or Praxis code, read the docs pack for your language, listed under Versions below. It matches the installed SDK, so prefer it over memory. Feature status is in `guide/capabilities.md`: never use a proposal as an API.

### Never generate (full forms and sources: `rules.md`)

- NG-01 SDK effect adapter: Timeout, signal, null exit or thrown error → UNKNOWN, never CONFIRMED_*. Praxis: Never call a timeout, signal, null exit or thrown error FAILED or success: it is UNKNOWN.
- NG-02 SDK effect adapter: Nonzero exit → CONFIRMED_NOT_APPLIED only with proof nothing changed; else UNKNOWN. Praxis: Never relabel an exit or a binding violation: a reported outcome is never rewritten.
- NG-03 Never auto-retry an UNKNOWN operation or wrap dispatch in retry-on-any-exception
- NG-04 Never retry an uncertain command with a new request ID or read NOT_FOUND as "nothing committed"
- NG-05 Never release or refund a DISPATCHED/UNKNOWN reservation without authoritative evidence
- NG-06 Never cap, hide, absorb or shift a cost overrun to a sibling; overruns hold for a human
- NG-07 Never dispatch an effect before its reservation and dispatch intent are durably committed
- NG-08 Never trust actor, isHuman or "HUMAN" from a request body; never write an allow-all authorizer
- NG-09 Never let an agent or rule change permissions or limits, reductions included, by any route
- NG-10 Never reset attempts, spend, reservations, approvals or deadlines on resume, retry or restore
- NG-11 Never freeze deadlines or expiry during a pause; PAUSED does not prove in-flight work stopped
- NG-12 Never treat a tool result, protocol event or summary as approval, PASS, acceptance or authority
- NG-13 Never record PASS or acceptance from an agent's self-report; missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE
- NG-14 Never reuse a remote (A2A/MCP) task ID as a local identity or append to a terminal A2A task
- NG-15 Never dispatch MCP/A2A without re-checking the capability digest against the reviewed one
- NG-16 Never use floats or JSON numbers for cost, time, revisions or epochs; use decimal strings
- NG-17 Never parse leniently: no unknown fields, enum values or versions, no duplicate keys
- NG-18 Never mutate an attached graph, plan or contract in place; propose a versioned, gated revision
- NG-19 Never reopen terminal execution or report a canceled work order as success or rollback
- NG-20 Never accept a stale owner's or epoch's result; never let a backward clock extend a lease
- NG-21 Never let an agent choose its accounting scope or purpose, or label ordinary work HANDOFF
- NG-22 Never make the basic checkpoint or handoff report depend on a paid model request
- NG-23 Never count a skipped, failed or merely dispatched input or branch as completed
- NG-24 Never reuse an approval after its material changed; a notification or click is not approval
- NG-25 Never put secrets in argv, plans, logs, handoffs, URLs, telemetry or database state
- NG-26 Never build an attempt's environment from the host environment (no spreading process.env)
- NG-27 Never fall back to another model, use a moving alias, or retry at a reported reset time
- NG-28 Never dispatch a model-using agent on DECLARED model requirements
- NG-29 Never read, copy or store a subscription login, or share a login directory between attempts
- NG-30 Never settle on a tool's estimate or below the allowance without a COMPLETE report or human evidence
- NG-31 Never treat a workspace directory, worktree or separate process as a sandbox
- NG-32 Never use cron, time zones or local wall-clock times in engine schedules; fixed UTC only
- NG-33 Never run attempt or credential commands through a shell string; use argv
- NG-34 Never expose raw stores or reducers as mutation handlers or give workers database access
- NG-35 Never approximate a scope hold or start work under a scope the runtime cannot fence
- NG-36 Never split one work-order tree across ledgers or sum separate mission databases

**Building your own host?** Read the host obligations in `rules.md` and `spec/engine-v1/HOST-CONTRACTS.md` first.

### Where to look (paths relative to your language's pack folder)

- Start here: feature status, the agent contract, first run: `guide/capabilities.md`, `guide/agents.md`, `guide/quickstart.md`
- Your language's SDK: `guide/<language>.md`, `guide/api-reference.md`
- Identity, grants and human approval: `guide/authorization.md`, `spec/engine-v1/AUTHENTICATION.md`, `spec/engine-v1/ACCESS-POLICY.md`
- Effects, UNKNOWN outcomes and reconciliation: `guide/effects.md`, `guide/recovery.md`, `spec/engine-v1/RECOVERY.md`
- Budgets and nested limits: `guide/budgets.md`, `spec/limits-v1/CONTRACT.md`
- Graphs, branches, triggers and waits: `guide/workflows.md`, `guide/control-flow.md`, `guide/triggers.md`, `guide/waits.md`
- Handoffs and holds: `guide/handoffs.md`, `spec/handoff-v1/CONTRACT.md`
- Verification and acceptance: `guide/verification.md`
- Persistence, replay and durability: `guide/durability.md`, `spec/engine-v1/WIRE.md`
- A complete host: `guide/reference-host.md`, `spec/engine-v1/HOST-CONTRACTS.md`, `rules.md`
- Praxis coding workflow and authoring: `guide/engine-coding-workflow.md`, `guide/engine-authoring.md`, `guide/engine-readiness.md`
- Praxis control API, CLI and operator view: `guide/engine-control-api.md`, `guide/engine-praxis-cli.md`, `guide/engine-operator-view.md`
- Dynamic workflows: `guide/engine-dynamic-workflows.md`, `spec/engine-v1/DYNAMIC-WORKFLOWS.md`
- MCP, A2A and AG-UI: `guide/engine-protocol-interoperability.md`, `spec/engine-v1/PROTOCOL-BINDINGS.md`
- Readiness 2.0.0: `spec/engine-v1/READINESS.md`, `spec/engine-v1/AGENT-BINDING-readiness-2.0.0.md`
- The standard (normative wording, not how-to): `spec/STANDARD.md`
- Runnable recipes: `recipes/`
- Glossary: `glossary.md`
freshClone: A fresh clone has no `.aiws/agent-docs/`: it is gitignored. Run the sync command on your language's line before reading the pack, and again whenever that version differs from the SDK version in your package manifest.
